name: Moroccan Chickpea Salad
notes: Discovered Summer 2020–a surprise in every bite. Can serve with Pita bread.

items: ⅓ cup toasted pistachios (or almonds, pumpkin seeds)
Onions, cucumber, other vegetables as desired
8+ Tbsp fresh lemon juice (enough to make the dressing taste “bright”)
2 tsp maple syrup (or honey) + more to keep the dressing from being sour

steps.title: Layer the bowl
steps.body: Layer in a bowl: greens (arugula is a good choice), **3 cups grated carrots**, **2 cans chickpeas**, **2 cups cooked quinoa**, **3 Tbsp chopped fresh mint**, **¼ cup golden raisins** (or figs/dates), **⅓ cup crumbled feta cheese**, **⅓ cup toasted pistachios** (or almonds, pumpkin seeds), cooked chicken if desired, and onions, cucumber, other vegetables as desired.

steps.title: Dress and toss
steps.body: Toss and top with dressing made of: **6 Tbsp olive oil**, **8+ Tbsp fresh lemon juice** (enough to make the dressing taste “bright”), **2 tsp Dijon mustard**, **2 tsp maple syrup** (or honey) + more to keep the dressing from being sour, **1½ tsp ground chili powder**, **1 tsp kosher salt** and **½ tsp ground cinnamon**.
